{{Quote|A landscape is as much what is behind our eyes as what is before them.|Twi'lek artist Mi'raj|<ref name="SWG:CS" />}}
'''Mi'raj''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who created the [[Painting/Legends|painting]] known as ''[[Corellian Seaside]]''.<ref name="SWG:CS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mi'raj is mentioned in the description of the painting, ''Corellian Seaside'', in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG:CS" />
